name: Look up from reference
description: Translates one value into another using a reference table — airport code → airport name, currency code → symbol, ISO country → country name, tax code → rate. Tip: drag a reference table from the palette onto the canvas to create one of these pre-wired.

inputs.name: matchOn
inputs.description: Map of reference-column → JSONPath whose values must match (e.g. { code: $.flight.origin }). Authored via the binding's extras.matchOn field, not as a regular port binding.

params.name: target
params.description: Field on the current record to write the looked-up value into.

params.name: referenceId
params.description: The reference table to look up against (e.g. ref-airports).

params.name: valueColumn
params.description: Which column of the reference row to copy into target.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do if no row in the reference table matches.

enum.label: Leave as-is
enum.description: Keep whatever was already in the target field.

enum.label: Skip this rule
enum.description: Stop the current iteration and move on.

enum.label: Use a default
enum.description: Write the configured default value into target.
